title: TorchNeuron is in public beta
body: Hugging Face put TorchNeuron, a native PyTorch backend for AWS Trainium, into public beta. Per the note, out-of-the-box support for the top-100 text-generation architectures goes from 46% to 89%. https://huggingface.co/blog/hf-torchneuron

lines: Signal on the Feed: TorchNeuron went public beta. Straight from the collected note, nothing added.
